hero.subtitle: We redirect money toward what is alive: ecosystems, communities and the commons. From extracting to regenerating.

what.title: What is ReFi?
what.lead: Regenerative Finance redirects money toward what is alive. Instead of extracting value, we build economies that restore ecological and social systems.
what.extractiveBody: Extracts for immediate gain, ignoring the long term.
what.sustainableBody: Balances resource use, but does not restore what is degraded.
what.regenerativeBody: Actively restores natural and social systems.

principles.title: What guides regenerative finance
principles.ecologicalBody: Finance aligned with the regeneration of the planet.
principles.holisticBody: Value beyond the financial: social, natural and cultural.
principles.equityBody: Closing inequalities and caring for every community.
principles.systemicBody: Economy, society and environment, deeply connected.
principles.circularBody: Minimize waste, maximize the regeneration of materials.

tech.title: The engine: onchain technology
tech.lead: ReFi relies on blockchain to do what traditional banking cannot: full transparency, programmable money and borderless access.
tech.transparencyBody: Anyone can audit the code and transactions onchain.
tech.programmableBody: Funds are released only when verifiable goals are met.
tech.realBody: It impacts tangible assets, like carbon credits.

nodes.lead: ReFi Colombia is a fabric of local communities. Each node activates regeneration in its territory.

transparency.lead: Our subsidy program lives in a public contract on Celo. Funds contributed and distributed can be audited in real time.

community.lead: ReFi Colombia is an open, collaborative movement. Bring your voice, your project or your curiosity.

campaign.title: Help Colombia after the earthquake
campaign.body: On August 10, 2026 a magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck Colombia. ReFi Colombia receives and manages donations onchain in USDC or USDT across five networks, and every contribution is publicly verifiable.
campaign.trust: Onchain donations in USDC or USDT across five networks, received and managed by ReFi Colombia, and publicly verifiable on the blockchain.
